crossRefs.note: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of…
I signed the deed, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed the money in the balances to him.

people.name: Boaz
people.line: Kinsman-redeemer who married Ruth, ancestor of David and Jesus

people.name: Chilion
people.line: Son of Elimelech and Naomi; husband of Orpah

people.name: Mahlon
people.line: Husband of Ruth, son of Elimelech and Naomi.

translations.web: Boaz said to the elders and to all the people, “You are witnesses today, that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, from the hand of Naomi.
translations.bsb: At this, Boaz said to the elders and all the people, “You are witnesses today that I am buying from Naomi all that belonged to Elimelech, Chilion, and Mahlon.
translations.kjv: And Boaz said unto the elders, and unto all the people, Ye are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech's, and all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's, of the hand of Naomi.
translations.asv: And Boaz said unto the elders, and unto all the people, Ye are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech's, and all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's, of the hand of Naomi.
